sources.citation: Zubair, Muhammad. 2016. A grammatical description of Wadiyari (thesis), section 2.3.2 'Sindh Survey Month' (p. 15) and Figure 14 (p. 23).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing about Ghera. Names Ghera as one of 27 groups 'not reported previously, not even in Grainger & Grainger (1980)' that were first documented in Jeffery (ed.) 1999 'Sindh Survey Month' (Karachi, unpublished SIL ms., 34 groups, morphological and lexical comparison); the classification figure adapted from Jeffery 1999 places Ghera under W. HINDI. The thesis's phonology concerns Wadiyari only.

sources.citation: Rahman, Tariq. 2004. Language policy, multilingualism and language vitality in Pakistan. Paper presented at SCALLA 2004 (open precursor of Rahman 2006, in Saxena & Borin (eds.), Lesser-known languages of South Asia, 73-106, Berlin: Mouton de Gruyter -- the only Glottolog reference for gher1238).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Ghera appears only as one row of the appendix table of minor languages of Pakistan ('Ghera | Sindhi Ghera, Bara | Hyderabad Sindh | 10,000 (in 1998) | Grimes 2000'), i.e. copied from Ethnologue 14. The words stress/accent/phonology do not occur in the paper.

sources.citation: Grimes, Barbara F. (ed.) 2000. Ethnologue: Languages of the World, 14th edition. Dallas: SIL International. Entry 'GHERA' [GHR] (web edition, Internet Archive copy 2002-01-06).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Population 10,000 or fewer (1998); a single colony in Hyderabad between the main bus stop and the railway station; speakers say >90% of the people remained in Surat and Ahmedabad, India; 'Quite different grammatically from Gurgula and similar to Urdu. 87% lexical similarity with Gurgula, 70% with Urdu'; 'Investigation needed: intelligibility, bilingual proficiency in India group'; sellers of ceramic dishes and used clothing; Hindu. No phonology.

sources.citation: Hammarström, Forkel, Haspelmath & Bank (eds.), Glottolog 5.3, languoid gher1238 'Ghera' (JSON record) and family node gher1240 'Ghera-Gurgula'; langdoc title searches 'Ghera' and 'Sindh Survey'.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Zero descriptive references; Glottolog's fullest description is only a wordlist (Rahman 2006). Title search 'Ghera' returns only unrelated items (Voghera, Gnoli's 'Gherardo'); 'Sindh Survey' returns 0; the family node has no references.

sources.citation: Joshua Project language page 'Ghera language resources' (joshuaproject.net/languages/ghr); PHOIBLE inventory index; Wikidata Q22808992.
sources.note: Nothing. Joshua Project lists 0 people groups and no resources for ghr; PHOIBLE has no inventory for ghr; Wikidata has only en/simple/pms/sw Wikipedia sitelinks and identifier claims.
